import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import *
def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(29500+ws))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 12); x = torch.randn(3, 12, requires_grad=True)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        ref = torch.nn.Linear(12, 8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        m = cls(12, 8, True, W)
        x1 = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); x2 = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        y = m(x1); yr = ref(x2)
        assert torch.allclose(y, yr, atol=1e-5)
        (y**2).sum().backward(); (yr**2).sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(x1.grad, x2.grad, atol=1e-5)
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            n = 8//ws; gw = ref.weight.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb = ref.bias.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]
        else:
            n = 12//ws; gw = ref.weight.grad[:, rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb = ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, gw, atol=1e-5) and torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, gb, atol=1e-5)
    if rank == 0: print("ok", ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws in (1, 2, 4): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
